data.name: Guna
data.gender_notes: Guna is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A bond or knot that ties together the universe, representing duty, virtue and power. The name Guna carries the meaning “Bond, Knot” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit. Parents who choose Guna usually hope their child will grow to embody bond, knot and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A spiritual force that influences the course of one's life.
data.etymology: Guna belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Bond, Knot.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Guna total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

data.cultural_impact: The term "Guna" has its roots in Hinduism and Jainism, referring to qualities or attributes that shape a person's actions, thoughts, and behaviors. In Hindu mythology, there are three Gunas or qualities that govern all existence - Sattva, Rajas, and Tamas. These Gunas determine an individual's nature, tendencies, and responses to various situations.
data.spiritual_significance: In Hindu spirituality, the concept of Gunas holds immense importance as they represent the fundamental aspects of the Self or Atman. The pursuit of spiritual growth involves recognizing these qualities within oneself and striving to maintain a balance between them. By understanding and cultivating the virtuous Gunas, individuals can progress on their spiritual journey towards enlightenment.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Guna signifies the qualities or virtues an individual embodies. It refers to the three fundamental qualities of Sattva (purity), Rajas (passion), and Tamas (inertia) that influence an individual's actions and thoughts.
